## Editors

- [Quillpad](https://github.com/example-owner/quillpad) - A tiny editor for notes.
- [Inkwell](https://inkwell.example.com/) – Writes plain text and nothing else.
- [Slate Board](https://github.com/example-owner/slate-board): Boards of cards.
- [No Words](https://example.com/no-words)

### Plugins

* [Quill Spell](https://github.com/Example-Owner/Quill-Spell.git) - Checks spelling in Quillpad.
